raw_extract:
### Fees

Tuition fees for home students commencing their studies in September 2027 will be £10,050 per annum. Tuition fees for international students will be £39,700 per annum.

For general information please see the [undergraduate finance](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/) pages.
research_notes: Requested the 2026-entry URL; the site served the 2027-entry course profile (page title 'BSc Computer Science (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester', canonical path /study/undergraduate/courses/2027/00560/bsc-computer-science/). The verbatim Fees line is recorded exactly as returned. The UK has no single national international tuition figure - fees are set per institution and per course, so this is one named university's price for one named course (BSc Computer Science, 3 years, UCAS G400). The same fetch also confirms the England home-fee cap of £10,050 for 2027/28, which is a different (domestic) figure and must not be used as the international number. A second Manchester course was fetched on the same 2027 cycle to show within-institution spread (see 001b file).

claims.statement: The University of Manchester charges international students £39,700 per annum for the BSc Computer Science (3 years, 2027 entry).
The same University of Manchester page states home (domestic) students commencing studies in September 2027 will pay £10,050 per annum - the England home fee cap figure, not the international rate.
